chunks: Al-Mu‘allā ibn Khunays also narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
"Whoever among you reaches the day of Jumu‘ah, let him not occupy himself with anything other than worship, for in it the servants are forgiven and mercy is sent down upon them."

key_terms.يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ: the day of Friday, a specially blessed day in Islam
key_terms.ٱلرَّحْمَةُ: divine mercy sent down by Allah
key_terms.ٱلْعِبَادَةِ: worship and acts of devotion to Allah
key_terms.ٱلْعِبَادِ: the servants, meaning the worshippers or people

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about spending the day of Jumu‘ah in worship?
ai.summary: This hadith urges the believers to devote the day of Jumu‘ah to worship and avoid distractions from 'ibadah. It highlights the special spiritual merit of this day, in which forgiveness is granted to the servants and divine mercy descends upon them.
